ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the $6 million scheme involving an autism center owner and explore potential connections to other Medicaid fraud cases in the state.
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can we prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and highlight the need for increased oversight and regulation.

ideas.title: Federal Immigration Officer Misconduct: A Pattern of Abuse?
ideas.description: Investigate the misconduct allegations against federal immigration officers during 'Operation Metro Surge' and explore potential connections to other similar cases.
questions: What is the scope of misconduct by federal immigration officers?
How can we hold them accountable?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a pattern of abuse by federal immigration officers and highlight the need for greater accountability and transparency.
